summary_1line: Narada teaches life’s unpredictability and detachment; Suka resolves to seek liberation through Yoga and union with the Sun’s effulgence.

image_candidates.scene_text: Suka stands beneath the open sky declaring to gods, mountains, trees, and all beings that he will enter the blazing Sun through the power of Yoga.
The young sage Suka calmly circles his father Vyasa, who looks at him with longing as the son prepares to leave worldly life forever.
On the lonely summit of Mount Kailasa, Suka sits facing the rising sun, limbs drawn in, beginning deep yogic concentration.
